_gender: Each gender here is a case or plural form whose Wiktionary entry ({{pl-head|noun form|…}}) carries no gender; it is the one on its lemma's own Polish headword, {{pl-noun|…}}: koty from kot (m-anml), jabłka from jabłko (n), ręce from ręka (f), książkę from książka (f), read 2026-11-21. Masculine nouns show their animacy (m, personal; m, animate; m, inanimate), which decides the accusative.
_claude_hints: Short hints where Wiktionary's first definition is long, merges several senses, or carries a usage bracket ([with instrumental]); each hint is taken from the cited Wiktionary definition of the word or its lemma.
